name: jw-mcp
description: MCP server for JW.org content: Bible verses with study notes, the meeting workbook, Watchtower study articles, the daily text, Watchtower Online Library search, and video transcripts

tools.name: search_bible_books
tools.description: Look up Bible books by name, abbreviation or number

tools.name: get_bible_verse
tools.description: Get New World Translation verse text in many languages

tools.name: get_verse_with_study
tools.description: Get verses with study notes, footnotes, cross references and research articles

tools.name: get_bible_verse_url
tools.description: Build jw.org links for Bible references

tools.name: getWorkbookLinks
tools.description: List the weeks of a meeting workbook issue

tools.name: getWorkbookContent
tools.description: Read a week of the meeting workbook (this week by default)

tools.name: getWatchtowerLinks
tools.description: List the articles of a Watchtower study edition

tools.name: getWatchtowerContent
tools.description: Read a Watchtower study article (this week by default)

tools.name: get_daily_text
tools.description: Get the daily text for a date

tools.name: read_wol_document
tools.description: Read a Watchtower Online Library document as text

tools.name: get_jw_captions
tools.description: Get a JW.org video transcript and metadata
